visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a black t-shirt and blue jeans sits cross-legged on a light wood floor. She faces the camera, positioned in a living room with a black record shelf and a green poster behind her. She looks at a large cardboard box in front of her. (2) Using a small box cutter, she starts slicing the tape on the box. Her facial expression is focused. A circular inset appears at the left, showing a second woman smiling. The background remains consistent with warm indoor lighting and a black desk lamp on the right. (3) The scene cuts to a flashback: the woman wears a pink t-shirt, looking at her phone while eating. The setting is a dimly lit dining area. Text overlays are prominent. This suggests a re-enactment of the purchase decision. (4) Returning to the living room, she pulls out a grey padded mailing bag from the larger box. She handles the objects with care. The record shelf behind her displays various vinyl covers, adding texture to the setting. (5) She unboxes a white, pleated paper lampshade from a black box labeled 'AKARI'. A second woman in a white graphic t-shirt and black leggings joins her. They both sit on the floor, inspecting the components and instructions with curious expressions. (6) A time-lapse sequence shows both women working together to assemble the wire tripod base and attach the paper shade. They use their hands in quick, coordinated movements. The camera remains static, capturing the full activity on the floor. (7) The lamp is successfully assembled and lit, emitting a soft, warm glow. The woman in the white shirt reacts dramatically, falling backward in joy. The room's atmosphere shifts with the addition of the lamp's light. The first woman stands to pose. (8) The two women sit beside the glowing lamp, smiling and talking directly to the camera. One woman holds a small yellow ball. The lighting highlights their happy facial expressions. They laugh together as the video concludes, reinforcing a warm, domestic vibe.

The transition back to the main scene is marked by a subtle whoosh SFX. (3) Rustling sounds of plastic and paper envelopes are prominent as the unboxing proceeds. The BGM remains steady in the background. The speakers maintain an animated dialogue with frequent laughter, indicating high emotional valence and positive arousal. No digital distortion is present. (6) The final phase features both women talking over the continuous acoustic BGM. The speech density is high as they joke about the price. The track finishes with clear, resonant laughter and a smooth fade-out of the music and voices, maintaining high signal-to-noise ratio.
